 Dated this the 29th day of September, 2025

The defacto complainant in S.C.No.322 of 2023 on the files of the Additional Special Court for the Trial of POCSO Act Cases, Muvattupuzha, has filed this original petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, for a direction for the speedy disposal of the aforesaid case.

entities.text: Additional Special Court for the Trial of POCSO Act Cases, Muvattupuzha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offences alleged against the accused in the said case are under Sections 366, 376(2) and 376(3) of the IPC and Section 67A of the IT Act and Section 4(2) read with Section 3(a), 12 read with 11(ii) and 11(iii)
and 6 read with 5(l) and 5(p) and 10 read with 9(l) of the POCSO Act.
2. As per order dated 14.08.2025, the Registry was directed to call for a report from the learned Special Judge as to the time required for the disposal of the aforesaid case.

Vide letter dated 10.09.2025, the learned Special Judge informed that the mobile phones, laptop, the victim's photographs and the victim's dresses, 2025:KER:72930 which were sent for scientific analysis at the Forensic Science Laboratory, are yet to be examined by the said laboratory and the reports are awaited.

Accordingly, it is submitted by the learned Special Judge that the case could be disposed of within a period of five months after receiving the examination reports from the Forensic Science Laboratories concerned.

In the light of the aforesaid report of the learned Special Judge, this original petition is closed with a direction to the Additional Special Court for Trial of POCSO Act cases, Muvattupuzha, to expedite the proceedings by issuing reminders to the Forensic Science Laboratories concerned, and to proceed with the trial immediately after receipt of the reports from the Forensic Science Laboratories concerned.
         Sd/-
 G. GIRISH  JUDGE ded/29.09.2025  2025:KER:72930  APPENDIX OF OP(CRL.)
